c74object.name: sounds~
c74object.description: sounds~ is a polyphonic MIDI-to-audio instrument that dynamically loads sound synthesis modules from the modules/ directory. It renders audio on-the-fly using a Just-In-Time rendering strategy to handle complex synthesis designs while maintaining polyphony and correct release phases. If an optional dictionary name argument is provided, sounds~ tracks active use duration in seconds for each preset in the named dict object using 1-based keys (e.g., "1", "2") defaulting to 1.0, and applies duration-weighted lottery sampling when receiving a random message.

objarg.name: dict-name
objarg.digest: Name of external dictionary for preset duration tracking
objarg.description: Optional symbol specifying the name of an external dict object to reference. When present, the active playtime duration in seconds of each preset (while at least one voice is active) is recorded under 1-based keys (e.g. "1": 1.0, "2": 1.0).

method.name: list
method.digest: Process MIDI Note-On and Note-Off messages
method.description: A list of two integers is treated as a MIDI note. The first integer is the note number (0-127), and the second is the velocity (0-127). A velocity greater than 0 triggers a note-on event; a velocity of 0 triggers a note-off event.

method.name: midievent
method.description: Accepts raw MIDI event lists as output by objects like midiformat. Supports Note On (144-159), Note Off (128-143), and Program Change (192-207 for changing presets).

method.name: preset
method.digest: Switch to a specific sound module (1-based)
method.description: Sets the active sound module to the one at the specified 1-based index (e.g., 1 for the first module sound_00001.dll, 2 for sound_00002.dll, etc.). Indices are assigned based on the alphabetical order of the five-digit padded DLL files in the modules/ directory.

method.name: random
method.digest: Switch to a random sound module
method.description: Randomly selects one of the available sound modules as the active preset. If an optional dictionary argument is specified, selection is weighted based on stored durations in the dictionary (favoring presets with more active playtime).
